input.answer: I found it: the "להבין סוג של חיסכון" card took me to a "מדריך" page with a card for each kind of saving, and the one I heard about is the "מדד S&P 500" card under "במה הכסף מושקע". It's tap that next, but I never saw what it says inside, so I can't say yet that it explains anything.

stuck.why: I read from the right, so the big form 'מה השאלה שלכם?' with all the buttons and ₪ fields grabbed me first. The 'להבין סוג של חיסכון' card is over on the left column and I nearly missed it.

It says every saving has 'איפה הכסף מוחזק' and 'במה הכסף מושקע'. I didn't get that, because to me S&P is the saving. I had to scroll past a whole wall of products like פיקדון, קרן השתלמות and pension before I found S&P in the second list.
About 12 index cards that all look the same (MSCI World, MSCI AC World, נאסד"ק, ת"א-35/90/125). It's too many lookalikes. I only stopped because I spotted 'S&P 500'.

used: Card 'להבין סוג של חיסכון – מה זה, כמה זה עולה ואיך זה ממוסה' on the home page
Guide heading 'מדריך – כל סוג של חיסכון והשקעה שהאתר מכסה'
skimmed: 'מאיפה להתחיל' links (קרן השתלמות, קרן חדשה מקיפה, קרן כספית)
'איפה הכסף מוחזק' cards: כסף שוטף וקצר, חיסכון עם הטבת מס, פרישה, לילדים, לבחירה עצמית
Other index cards in the 'במה הכסף מושקע' grid
skipped: Home form fields (יש לכם היום / ובכל חודש / כמה שנים) and the 'מה הכי מתאים' button
'שאלות שכולם שואלים' box on the home page
Small grey lines (אתר אישי, לא מסחרי…, נתונים נכון ל-26.10.2026)
not_found: What actually opens when you tap 'מדד S&P 500'. I didn't see that screen.
A plain 'start here if you have 30,000 ₪' pointer

findings.what: S&P 500 isn't under the products. It's hidden in a second grid, 'במה הכסף מושקע', way down the guide after about 20 product cards. Someone who heard of 'the S&P' has to scroll through everything first.
The card that answers 'explain a kind of saving to me' is on the left column. The right side, where I start reading, is taken by a big form.
Too many lookalike cards (about 30) with the same grey look. Twelve index cards in a row is the point where I'd want to just close it.
מק"מ shows up twice, once as a product and once as an investment, and I don't know what it is anyway.
findings.where: Guide page, 'כסף שוטף וקצר' and 'במה הכסף מושקע'

findings.what: The 'two parts of every saving' idea is the key to the page, but it's a short dense paragraph I didn't really take in.
Jargon inside the card blurbs ('חשיפה לדולר או מנוטרלת ממנו', 'קרן שעוקבת אחריו').
